name: kinconductor
description: KinConductor KC868-A6 firmware with calibrated current inputs, hostname/mDNS, grouped WebGUI, eight independent BLE presence targets, per-rule UDP/serial IFTTT, PWM and OLED grids

scripts.test: npm run test:native && npm run test:web
scripts.test:web: node --check data/app.js && node --check data/capabilities.js && node --test test/test_web.js test/test_capability_ui.js test/test_release.js

author: Robert Rupa
